scope: Agent inspected decoded final start/action/result/return frames for every changed insert, plus 375px mobile contact sheet; source action reviewed as ordered decoded frames.

sourceActionReview.method: Ordered source frames at0.5–2seconds; continuous sound review not inferred
sourceActionReview.notes: Three different visible actions: selected-part translation/placement; native rotation; camera orbit. Three meaningful examples within one game; no repeated action counted to meet quota.

limits: Frame inspection is not continuous full-video viewing or full-audio listening.
Game imagery is observable evidence; exact hidden quantities are only in the labeled explanation model.
